narrative.northStar: The Warung Kitchen in Tonal Colour
narrative.overview:
H One FoodBiz is a warm consumer app wearing Material You, not a grey SaaS admin. The ground is a peach-tinted paper (surface), cards sit on it as white sheets or as soft tonal containers (orange, turmeric, pandan green), and every pressable thing gives under the thumb and springs back. Colour is spread across regions through M3 container roles so the screens feel lively and owned; the most saturated orange is reserved for the things you can press.

Density is phone-first and generous: 48px minimum targets, 64px list rows, 28px card corners, short rounded humanist type. On wide screens the same cards rearrange into a two-column grid beside a navigation rail; on phones they stack above a bottom bar with a raised centre add button. Light and dark schemes are both first-class, swapped wholesale through the same role names.
keyCharacteristics: M3 tonal roles in three families: warung orange (primary), turmeric (secondary), pandan (tertiary), all on a warm peach neutral.
Solid primary fill only on pressable elements; regions carry colour through containers.
Large soft radii (28px cards, pill buttons); nothing interactive has a square corner.
Nunito 800 headlines over Nunito Sans body, tight leading on big titles.
Spring press (scale 0.96) on every button, card link, list row and chip.
Outline icons inside rounded tonal tiles, never bare glyphs.

rules.name: The Pressable Saturation Rule
rules.body: Solid primary orange fills only pressable things (filled button, phone add button, selected chip, switch-on) and the focus ring. Regions, cards and tiles get colour through `*-container` roles, never through the primary fill.

rules.name: The Pair Rule
rules.body: A container background always takes its own `on-*-container` text colour. Contrast is guaranteed by the pair; never mix families (no on-primary-container text on a tertiary container).

rules.name: The Three-Container Rotation
rules.body: Sibling items that need distinction (outlet cards, quick-action tiles, auth facts) rotate primary, tertiary and secondary containers instead of inventing new hues.

rules.name: The Two-Nunito Rule
rules.body: h1–h3 and the wordmark use Nunito 800/700; everything else is Nunito Sans. No third family except system mono for machine codes.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every number a user compares (rupiah amounts, counts, percentages, progress "3 dari 5") uses tabular figures (`.num`); the rupiah field shows a fixed "Rp" prefix inside the input.

rules.name: No Eyebrows
rules.body: Headings stand alone; no uppercase kicker or tracked label above a title.

rules.name: The Surface-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows sit only on white surface cards and on primary actions. A tonal container never gets a shadow; its colour already separates it.

rules.name: The Nothing-Square Rule
rules.body: No interactive or container element has a radius under 8px.

rules.name: The One Loud Add Rule
rules.body: The add button changes emphasis by breakpoint on purpose. On the rail it is the M3 tonal FAB: primary-container fill, card shadow at rest, raised shadow on hover. The rail sits beside page content that has its own filled buttons, so the add button stays tonal. On the phone bar it is the most prominent action on screen: solid primary fill, raised shadow at rest, lifted 28px above the bar. Keep these two treatments. Don't unify them, and don't give the bar's neighbouring destinations a fill.

dos: Do put colour on regions through `*-container` roles and keep solid primary (#c2410c) for pressable elements and focus.
Do pair every container with its own `on-*-container` text colour.
Do give every button, card link, list row and chip the `.press` spring (scale 0.96, `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.25, 0.64, 1)`), and let `prefers-reduced-motion` zero it.
Do keep touch targets at 48px or more and list rows at 64px.
Do use tabular figures and an "Rp" prefix for money; format rupiah without decimals.
Do place icons inside tonal tiles (44px/16px or 56px/20px), outline style.
Do define every colour through the role variables so the dark scheme swaps cleanly.
Do separate groups inside a tonal card with hairline dividers in its own ink (on-*-container at 15%), not with nested panels.
donts: Don't build the grey sidebar-and-table SaaS admin; this is a warm consumer app.
Don't fill cards, banners or tiles with solid primary orange.
Don't put shadows on tonal containers.
Don't add decorative progress rings or uppercase eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use emoji or glyph characters as icons.
Don't introduce a hue outside the orange, turmeric, pandan, error and warm-neutral families.
Don't use corners under 8px or square buttons.
Don't nest a white inner panel inside a tonal card to hold its main action.
